backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining backend logic for a concrete coating business, handling quote request and customer review submission/retrieval with in-memory maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single completed feature: updating the HeroSection tagline text capitalization, with associated file, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document providing short descriptive summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference for the app's component structure and content.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including sidebar and chart variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'NewGate Concrete Coating' and mounting the app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that composes the full page layout by rendering Navigation, HeroSection, AboutSection, ServicesSection, FlakeColorsSection, ContactSection, ReviewsSection, and Footer in order.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component displaying four polyaspartic coating benefit cards with icons, a service areas badge list (Orlando, Tampa, Plant City), and a 'NewGate Difference' highlight block.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form component with fields for name, email, phone, service type, and message that submits quote requests to the backend actor, showing a success state after submission.
frontend/src/components/FlakeColorsSecti: Section displaying 17 decorative chip flake color options in a responsive grid, each with a local image and color name, plus a CTA link to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, social media links, quick navigation links, and contact/service area details for NewGate Concrete Coating.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, company tagline, phone CTA, and buttons to scroll to the contact or services sections.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware styling, smooth-scroll nav links, and a responsive mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Displays customer reviews fetched from the backend and provides a form for submitting new reviews with star rating, service type, and feedback fields.
Renders a grid of four service cards (patio, driveway, pool deck, garage) each with an image, description, and feature tags.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating quote requests and customer reviews via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines a concrete/copper-themed design token system using OKLCH CSS variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with OKLCH-based color tokens (copper, concrete, chart, sidebar), custom border radii, fonts, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Tracks project state metadata including version, existing features, and a pending task to fix capitalization of the HeroSection tagline text.
